Pope addresses US anniversary, Trump marks event with partisan remarks

As the United States celebrated its 250th anniversary, Pope Leo delivered remarks on Lampedusa, praising the nation's history of welcoming immigrants and urging compassion. Meanwhile, Donald Trump marked the occasion with a speech that blended patriotism and partisanship. Other international figures and Indian Prime Minister Modi also extended congratulations.
